summary: Added optional Conversation initiative: Veyra can start a brief, context-aware conversation instead of only responding to questions.
instructions: In Chat, open Settings → Conversation initiative. Use Try a check-in now to request one tool-free model check-in; it works while paused and during quiet hours, but requires a connected service and no draft or pending work. Save Enabled to allow automatic check-ins, choose a 15-minute to 4-hour interval, and set quiet hours using the clock on Veyra’s computer (equal hours disables the quiet period). Check-ins are off by default. Automatic check-ins require visible Chat with no draft, open settings, work, or command approval, and stop nudging until you send another message. They use your selected service and recent chat context; API calls may incur charges. The model may skip a check-in if it has nothing useful to add. Save Paused to stop future automatic check-ins and suppress an in-flight check-in; an already-started model call may still incur usage. Preferences survive restarts. Scheduling, no-tool execution, authentication boundaries, desktop/mobile controls, drafts, and deferred updates were tested without live model calls.
